added: Each named phrase of an English dance has a Beats per bar field beside its Bars, so a tune that changes meter, such as an A in 3/4 and a B in 6/8, can be set up without typing the phrase structure by hand. The dance is then counted in bars phrase by phrase.
changed: Editing an English dance's Meter no longer resets the beats to the bar you set for each phrase. It sets them only when every phrase has the same beats and the Meter now states other beats than it did; phrases that differ, a word added after "3/4", or a Meter that names two meters such as "3/4 and 6/8" leave them alone.
